name: Aelthalyste
summary: In the Undercity's War Quarter, Aelthalyste trains Forsaken priests in the power of Shadow. She guides their spiritual discipline and sends troll acolytes to their own elders in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Voice of the Forgotten Shadow
sections.body: Aelthalyste trains Forsaken priests in the power of Shadow. While many priests across Azeroth revere the Holy Light, her students have turned from it. She rose as an incorporeal banshee and shares the spectral agony and relentless resolve of Sylvanas Windrunner's followers. From her chamber in the Undercity's War Quarter, she calls aspiring priests from distant outposts to master their darker arts. She teaches them to harness suffering as a weapon.

sections.title: Ties with the Horde
sections.body: Aelthalyste respects the spiritual traditions of other Horde practitioners. She sends troll initiates away from her shadow teachings, directing them across the sea to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar, where they can learn Darkspear spiritualism. Her deference lets Horde spellcasters develop within their own traditions and strengthens ties between Kalimdor and Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Aelthalyste is a banshee and a leading teacher of the Forsaken priesthood. In the War Quarter of the Undercity, she trains Forsaken practitioners in Shadow magic.
Aelthalyste can be found in the War Quarter beneath the ruins of Capital City, in the Undercity. Fellow Forsaken instructors are nearby.
Many Forsaken priests believe the Holy Light abandoned them in undeath. They have turned from the Light they revered in life toward shadow, embracing darkness, willpower, and personal discipline.

faq.q: Why does Aelthalyste send troll priests to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Aelthalyste sends troll priests to Orgrimmar because troll ties to spirits and shadow differ from Forsaken doctrine. She respects that difference and sends troll acolytes to train with Ur'kyo, the Darkspear priest trainer in the Valley of Spirits.
Aelthalyste gives Forsaken characters core priest instruction and guides advanced acolytes in undead rites. Her teachings include spells such as Touch of Weakness and Dark Sacrifice.
Yes. Aelthalyste is a banshee in the Undercity who serves Sylvanas Windrunner. She works to strengthen the Forsaken through mastery of dark magic.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, you find in Aelthalyste a teacher of your doctrine, dark spells, and the ways of shadow.
As an Undead, you share the Forsaken turn from the Holy Light of former lives toward the practical power of Shadow.
As a troll, you are directed by Aelthalyste to learn Darkspear rites from Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
As a member of the Horde, you can see Aelthalyste's respect for Ur'kyo's teachings helping bridge the coalition's cultural divides.
